title: Dragon's Hoard
about: Spin for treasure, trigger free spins, grow the Dragon's Hoard meter, and carve winning seams through a play-money arcade slot.

Three or more Dragon Fire scatters award free spins, where wilds expand to fill their reel and every line win is doubled. Every Dragon Egg that lands banks its stake into the Dragon's Hoard meter; fill the meter and the hoard hatches into an instant prize.

When enough of one treasure lands at once, a seam runs through the board and the reels stop for it — and wait for you. Widen the seam into the symbols around it, deepen it a place up the paytable, or gild it and multiply whatever the board is already paying. The board is then read again and you keep what the seam added. Wilds, scatters and eggs are left alone.
This is a play-money arcade slot. Credits are a local score — there are no purchases, no real currency, and nothing of value is wagered.
